description: Create and present file outputs, revise an artifact, or present an existing local file.

function.name: create_artifact
function.description: Create and present a file artifact. A .pdf filename renders Markdown content into a Unicode PDF with automatic pagination; other filenames save UTF-8 text. Saved in a unique workspace folder; never overwrites user files.

filename.description: Descriptive filename with extension, without directories.

content.description: Complete UTF-8 text, or Markdown to render when filename ends in .pdf. No PDF library, script, font setup or base64 encoding is needed.

function.name: update_artifact
function.description: Replace an artifact and update its card. PDF artifacts render the supplied Markdown into a new PDF; other files save UTF-8 text. Inspect existing content before replacing it.

id.description: Artifact id returned by create_artifact or publish_artifact.

content.description: Complete replacement text, or Markdown for a PDF artifact.

function.name: publish_artifact
function.description: Present an existing readable local file as a clickable chat output. Clicking reveals it in Files; it is not copied or executed.

path.description: Absolute path to an existing local file.

function.name: save_artifact_project
function.description: Register a generated artifact directory as a Pilon project when the user asks to save it as a project. Files stay in place and runtimes remain shared.

path.description: Absolute directory inside this chat artifact workspace.
